items.event_time_ist: ~4:50 PM IST, Oct 16 - early morning IST, Oct 17
items.source_name: The Indian Express / The Hindu (via btin.co.in, scoopfeeds.com)
items.summary: New corroborated details flesh out Friday's Oct-16 detentions (already alerted): The Indian Express reports more than 20 police personnel visited Abhijeet Dipke's Karol Bagh residence and served a notice barring the Connaught Place demonstration (citing disruption to traders, commuters, patients; CP not a designated protest site). Dipke was detained ~4:50 PM IST Oct 16 after leaving the residence; on being stopped he asked 'I am alone. Why are you stopping me?' and unfurled the national flag before officers moved him into a police vehicle. Police sources said he was taken to Jaffarpur Kalan PS in southwest Delhi, where preventive detention was considered. Separately, AISA claims Neha Bora was moved between locations across Delhi for ~5 hours after her Mandi House detention and taken to RK Puram PS, where lawyers who reached around midnight were not allowed to meet her (via The Hindu). Dipke's SEM-court production is expected later today, Oct 17.
items.title: New details on the Oct-16 Dipke/Bora detentions ahead of the 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march

items.summary: In an official Instagram post (~4:38 PM IST Oct 16) that earlier IG-CLI pulls missed due to cache gaps, CJP's party account said it had written to the SHO and the Commissioner of Police, Delhi, for 'immediate information and release of @abhijeetdipke from his illegal detention' ahead of the 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march. Self-reported by the party; no independent confirmation of the letters or any response.
items.title: CJP wrote to Delhi Police SHO and CP demanding Dipke's information and release
